actors.name: Tidepool
actors.private_context: Tidepool is sending a launch email to its newsletter subscribers. It has a beta waitlist and wants to maximize signups. The email includes a personal note from the founder and the waitlist link is above the fold.

actors.name: Newsletter Subscribers (cohort of 5000)
actors.private_context: Each subscriber receives the Tidepool newsletter. Their typical click-through rate is 6%. They may or may not be interested in joining a beta waitlist.

shared_context: Tidepool has a newsletter with 5000 subscribers. On launch morning (2026-09-22T08:00:00-07:00), Tidepool sends an email to all subscribers promoting a beta waitlist. The email includes a personal note from the founder and the waitlist link is above the fold. The typical click-through rate for the newsletter is 6%.

starting_events.description: Tidepool sends the launch email to all 5000 newsletter subscribers.

resolution: Resolve YES if the persistent event history shows that at least 200 distinct subscribers clicked through to join the beta waitlist within 72 hours of the email send (i.e., by 2026-09-25T08:00:00-07:00). Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
